welcome.title: How does it work?
welcome.intro: Five minutes and you're ready. Here's how the game works:

squad.title: Build your squad
squad.body: Pick {count} real players from the league with a {budget} budget. Max {max} per club.

lineup.title: Set your eleven
lineup.body: Every gameweek you pick 11 starters, your bench, and a captain who scores double.

points.title: Score real points
points.body: Goals, assists, clean sheets and more, based on what happens in the real matches.

compete.title: Compete with everyone
compete.body: Make transfers between gameweeks, climb the overall ranking and create leagues with friends.

lineup.title: Pick your starting eleven
lineup.hint: Tap a player, then tap who should take their place. On the bench, the order sets auto-substitution priority.

errors.swap_gk: The goalkeeper can only be swapped with the other goalkeeper.
errors.swap_formation: That swap breaks the minimum formation ({def} DEF, {mid} MID, {fwd} FWD).

captain.title: Captain and vice
captain.hint: Your captain scores double points. If they don't play, the vice-captain steps in.

errors.team_name_invalid: Team name must be between 3 and 30 characters.

errors.invalid_squad: The selection is not valid. Check your squad.

errors.captain_invalid: Pick a distinct captain and vice from your starting eleven.

scoring.intro: Set the points for each event. Applies to results entered from now on.

gameweeks.confirmFinalize: Finalize gameweek {number}? Points, auto-subs and rankings will be computed. This cannot be undone.
gameweeks.finalizeConfirmBody: Points, auto-subs and rankings will be computed. This can't be undone.
gameweeks.recomputeConfirmBody: The deadline moves to the configured offset before the first kickoff.
gameweeks.deleteCascade: This also removes the saved lineups, transfers and chips for this gameweek.
gameweeks.deleteFinished: This gameweek is already finalized — its points are counted in the standings and it can't be deleted.

results.intro: Pick a fixture to enter the result and player stats.

result.autoHint: Goals conceded and clean sheets are derived automatically from the score and minutes (60+). Points are computed on save.
result.bonusHint: Pick the 3 best players of the match (3, 2 and 1 extra points).
result.clockHint: Minutes played are derived from the lineup and substitutions against this clock. Sync it to real time or jump to full time.
result.lineupsHint: Pick each team's starting eleven. Only these players appear in the Live tab, and their minutes run from kick-off until they're subbed off.
result.rapidHint: Tap an action, then tap the player it belongs to.
result.rapidArmed: {action} armed — now tap a player on the pitch.
result.subPrompt: {name} comes off at {minute}' — tap who comes on.
result.publishConfirmBody: Minutes are frozen at full time and the match closes so the gameweek can be finalized. You can reopen it afterwards.

settings.budgetHint: Budget is stored in tenths: 1000 = $100.0 million.
